items.description: This should probably hurt more than it does.

items.description: Mostly harmless, unless you're very persistent.

items.description: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.

items.description: The gnarled body parts of a strange, offputting creature.

items.name: Writhan Trophy
items.description: Tough dead, it should probably be handled delicately.

items.description: An energetic glowing mushroom.
